an3.150:1.1: Tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bālo avyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ ca apuññaṃ pasavati.
an3.150:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo avyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ ca apuññaṃ pasavati.
an3.150:2.1: Tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito vyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ ca puññaṃ pasavati.
an3.150:2.3: Kusalena kāyakammena, kusalena vacīkammena, kusalena manokammena . . . 146. . . .
